title: Pregnant Blend 2-Mix Solo #22 (세로 띠 4구역·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Japanese woman, an adult, in her late 50s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, a sweet princess-like smile, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real pores, real living eyes, 150 studs piercings set with rubies in copper-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of rose-gold an anklet. Full body painted in 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 4 regions of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 vertical bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 23% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 41% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 62% of the way across her figure from her left edge. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it is painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, with floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 2. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
